visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair wearing a gray hoodie holds a 'Simple Fit' salad bowl in front of the camera. An orange and white cat is perched on his shoulder, curiously looking at the food. The background is a dimly lit indoor room. (2) The man is shown holding a smartphone displaying the FamilyMart app with a map interface. He uses his thumb to navigate the screen. The scene transitions to him standing outside at night in front of a storefront, holding another packaged food item. (3) A fast-paced montage begins where the man is seen in different settings (indoors, outdoors, and at a store counter) eating various packaged meals including rice balls and salads. He wears a black baseball cap in several shots. (4) The man stands in a brightly lit indoor space wearing a white tank top and a baseball cap. He holds a silver pouch of 'VERVE' protein powder, empties it into a white shaker bottle, and drinks it vigorously. (5) In the final phase, the man is in a gym with professional lighting and mirrors. He is shirtless, displaying a muscular physique, while looking at a clipboard. He talks to the camera, gesturing with his hands to emphasize the results.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration in Mandarin begins over an upbeat electronic dance music track. A digital 'click' SFX triggers as the speaker mentions the app. The vocal pitch is moderately high with dynamic inflection. (2) The narration continues with a fast tempo, synchronized with fast visual cuts. A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect is heard during a scene transition. The background music maintains a strong, consistent 4/4 beat. (3) Crinkling sounds of plastic packaging are audible as the man handles food items. The speaker's voice remains energetic and clear, with minimal background ambient noise interference. (4) The sound of liquid shaking in a bottle is clearly heard as the protein shake is prepared. The speaker's arousal level increases, sounding enthusiastic about the product. (5) In the final segment, the music swells slightly as the man reports his weight loss statistics. His tone becomes more authoritative and focused. A final digital UI sound effect marks the end of the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a one-week fitness challenge where the creator eats exclusively discounted convenience store food ('i珍食') to lose body fat. It serves as both a lifestyle vlog and an endorsement for FamilyMart's fresh food selection and Verve protein products, demonstrating that a healthy diet can be maintained conveniently and affordably.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent display of brand logos (FamilyMart, Verve), use of the store's app, and direct mention of specific products as part of the weight loss strategy.
